modules.description: PRESENT-80 lightweight block cipher: serial load of 80-bit key + 64-bit plaintext, 32-cycle iterative encryption, serial unload of 64-bit ciphertext; fully flat with inlined S-box, pLayer, key schedule, FSM, and counters.
modules.name: present80

ports.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in MSB-first while high
ports.name: load_en

ports.description: Serial data input: key[79:0] then plaintext[63:0], MSB first
ports.name: din

ports.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted
ports.name: shift_out_en

ports.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
ports.name: done

rationale: The spec mandates a single flat module with no sub-modules. All functional blocks (4-bit S-box lookup table, bit-permutation pLayer with P(i)=(i*16) mod 63, key schedule with 61-bit left rotation plus S-box on top nibble plus round-counter XOR into bits [19:15], addRoundKey XOR, iterative 32-cycle encrypt FSM, 8-bit load counter, 5-bit round counter, 6-bit unload counter, serial shift-in and shift-out paths, and done flag) are inlined directly inside the single present80 module.
